en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large outdoor café or beer‑garden set beneath rows of tall trees. Numerous small tables and chairs with patterned tablecloths fill the foreground, with many waiters and waitresses in aprons standing ready. On the left is a long glass‑fronted pavilion with ornate decoration; on the right is a multi‑story European building with storefronts at ground level. The image border suggests a printed postcard, and faint inverted text appears along the edges.
